g.text: SODA3.15.2 temperature, salinity and current. Main integrals use complete calendar months (152 days in both years).
Monthly climatological density surfaces fix section geometry; instantaneous surfaces are evaluated separately.
Chen (2015) density threshold applied to a regional 5N gate; this is not a closed heat budget or basin-wide WWV.
